title: ContextFeatureWindow
description: A feature derived from an external source and joined to a run window. Reading one always answers two questions: what value was joined, and under which measured agreement regime it was produced.

processing_version.description: Version of the code that produced this value.

temporal_mismatch_s.description: Signed offset between the window and the context timestamp actually used.

context_uncertainty.description: A regime property, not a per-row observed error: there is no ground truth to subtract. Error statistics live in the referenced ValidationArtifact and are not replicated onto every row.

validation_model_id.description: Identifier of the ValidationArtifact this uncertainty is drawn from.

validation_regime.description: The regime, and therefore the population, to which the estimate applies.

applicable.description: False where this row falls outside every validated regime. Such rows are not silently treated as validated.
